# Post-match timing observations

Source: [Post-Game Screen Timestamps](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1855); page edited 2023-04-12. Evidence: archived documentation; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/1855.md#wiki-1855) before using these values.

Offsets begin when the match becomes complete. Archived 2023-04-12; mode/UI changes may alter timings. Use actual match state where possible instead of depending solely on these delays.
